race.comment: JAY MILLER (5) made it two wins in a row at his latest appearance over 1680m at Launceston, scoring by 6 metres after taking charge a long way from home. Good enough to win a race of this calibre. COLORADO GIRL (3) ran second last start at this track over 1609m, beaten 3.5 metres. Has ability and should be right in the finish. COOLANDCOLLECT (6) is heading the right way, improving last time out to finish third at this track over 1609m. Genuine threat. SWEET AMOUR (11) is also in contention although the draw makes her job a bit tougher.
